title: Apply for a business Tax File Number (TFN)
summary: This page explains that applying for an Australian Business Number (ABN) will automatically issue a business Tax File Number (TFN) for partnerships, companies, or trusts.
intro:
The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) will automatically issue your partnership, company or trust with a business TFN when you apply for an Australian Business Number (ABN).

The form will also:

If you are starting a business, visit the Australian Government's Guide to starting a business.
